$comment: J's Studio (the admin Studio) runs no products since 2026-11-02 (J: "delete them off admin"): every Hawkes product moved to J's own customer Studio, the cell j-studio-4f12 (studio.hawkesgen.ai/o/j-studio-4f12/), whose repos' hooks point there. The list they had is the tests' fixture, test/fixture/j-products.json (test/setup-env.ts). A product added here again uses that file's fields. Every Hawkes product Studio builds, playtests and reports on. Paths are relative to C:\Projects. local.serve: how Studio starts the product locally for playtests (npm: the dev server; static: python's http.server over a folder). playtests: what runs each day (where: local or live). quality: the quality bar, what "done" means for the product; reviews judge against it, and a scenario that meets it gets regression-only daily reviews until its build changes meaningfully (src/review.ts). Scenarios come from each game's playtest contract (docs/playtest.md). dev: developing on beta (src/dev.ts): front = the /dev/ front door port Caddy routes https://<sub>.hawkesgen.ai/dev/* to, port = the dev server port in the beta working copy (web products), path = the devtools page.

infra.name: Hawkes Studio
infra.about: J's cockpit (studio.hawkesgen.ai): the daily build/playtest/review loop, backlog, reports, agent changes, beta lane and go live, Talk. Node 24 + TypeScript (type stripping), a plain-JS dashboard.

infra.name: Hawkes Gen
infra.about: The shared generative-AI service (hawkesgen.ai): the job queue, the AWS GPU fleet (ComfyUI), ElevenLabs, Claude, local tools, the library, usage and API keys, the build server and the playtester. Node 24 + TypeScript (type stripping), a plain-JS dashboard.

$comment_infra: Hawkes Studio and Hawkes Gen as agent targets (src/agents.ts): a change is a pull request into main (no beta lane), verified by CI on the pull request, the checks and a smoke check of the changed service on a spare port. Approving merges into main, and the server deploys it itself. Not in "repos": the server's checkouts of these two only move through deploy/hawkes-pull.mjs.
$comment_repos: GitHub repo for each top-level folder (the server clones them into the same layout as C:\Projects).

repoSetup.$comment: Run on the server after a repo is cloned or fast-forwarded (src/repos.ts), in the repo's folder. hawkes-assets: git keeps what the files are, S3 keeps the files (its README).

$comment_previews: Beta sites: https://<subdomain>.hawkesgen.ai/ is the product built from its beta branch (what going live ships), /c/<change id>/ an agent change (src/previews.ts; DNS and Caddy in deploy/deploy.mjs). Same login as Studio.
